I’ve been having this issue since August.

Here's the log. 

2025.12.28 16:51:57 Error      -  [API] [179, 403, Get, -1 https://api.vrchat.cloud/api/1/analysis/file_247bd88d-5fcf-4f4b-b9f5-5d18d928a21e/23/security] Abandoning request, because - File forbidden

2025.12.28 16:51:57 Error      -  Error Downloading or Instantiating Custom Scene - Star Catalogue - 10

I’ve tried a lot of different fixes(reuploading with new world ID, updating SDK, deleting files not being used,) but at this point I’m completely stuck.

and this keep happens to another test upload of this world project:

'wrld_24aef184-d7eb-452b-9e47-a530dab97d42' 

It looks like others have had the same issue here:

https://feedback.vrchat.com/open-beta/p/1675-world-fails-to-load-on-open-beta-due-to-file-forbidden

That post says all reported cases have been handled, but my worlds still won’t load. Perhaps its due to something new i guess? So I’m making a new post.
title: [1770] World fails to load due to file forbidden. (World '...' did not pass initial checks and won't be downloaded: 10 )
